summary: Game-created typeless camera with an independently selected actual RTV now chooses D3D11 Copy/Resolve versus shader Stretch using physical view provenance. Both stereo-eye preflight routes and compiler availability are checked before GPU writes; no D3D9Ex or input fallback activation changes.

feature_contract.goal: Route actual menu, car-selection and race source-camera postpasses to native stereo GPU color using observed physical RTV formats, with both-eye preflight and fail-closed original D3D9Ex output.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: An exact game-authored source camera typed view matching the eye enables GPU Copy/Resolve; alternate typed RTV invokes shader color conversion.
Before either eye queues commands, every raw camera candidate with another legal view preflights a GPU shader fallback and compiler dependency.
Unknown, mixed, depth or foreign camera views remain rejected, keeping original D3D9Ex presentation, input and FFB untouched.
Fast, Backend, Windows Build, OpenXR and HUD validate the same feature source SHA; game/Quest3 runtime remains UNTESTED.

integration_path: intercepted real D3D9 menu/car/race source camera Draw/Clear
observed physical D3D11 RTV format and native GPU copy route
two-eye SourceCopy preflight including shader fallback
D3D11 Copy/Resolve or native shader Stretch to eye color
GPU eye ring/OpenXR transport with original D3D9Ex fallback

acceptance_proof.positive_probe: Header compile-time static_assert covers matching game RTV raw copy and mismatched game RTV shader conversion; Fast regression executes routed SourceCopy check.
acceptance_proof.negative_regression: Unknown/depth/mixed typeless physical views reject; earlier 01039-01041 regressions preserved and DX9Ex rendering remains original.
acceptance_proof.component_integration: NativeGameEyeDrawEncoder copy_game_surface routes runtime physical RTV, while NativeGameStereoSubmission validates both possible routes and compiler before L/R ring GPU recording.

development_strategy.activation_guard_and_fallback: Existing opt-in NativeDrawPathActive=false and original D3D9Ex/menu/race/input/FFB remain authoritative; DXVK frozen
